name: educonnect
description: EduConnect - virtual classroom and online tutoring platform (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:prod: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
